## Fraud Detection  
**Fintech | High-stakes classification | Risk & compliance**

![](/assets/images/fraud-detection-banner.png){.banner fig-alt="Visualization of a fraud detection decision system showing intervention thresholds."}

<div class="metrics-box">
<strong>Impact Snapshot</strong><br>
• 20–35% reduction in manual review volume<br>
• Stabilized fraud loss volatility during peak load<br>
• Audit-ready intervention traceability implemented
</div>

### Decision Context  
Fraud exposure was rising while manual review queues expanded. Existing rules-based controls produced high false positives and lacked defensible audit logic under regulatory scrutiny.

### Decision at Stake  
Which transactions require intervention and where thresholds should be set to minimize loss without exceeding operational capacity or compliance guardrails.

### Business Risk  
- Escalating fraud losses  
- Review team saturation  
- Regulatory exposure from opaque decisions  
- Uncontrolled threshold adjustments  

### My Approach  
Reframed fraud prediction as intervention optimization.

- Modeled asymmetric cost of false positives and false negatives  
- Embedded review throughput constraints into threshold design  
- Aligned acceptable error modes with compliance leadership  
- Implemented hybrid rules plus ML architecture  
- Formalized threshold governance process  

![](/assets/images/fraud-detection-architecture.png){.case-diagram fig-alt="Audit-ready fraud intervention decision system architecture showing data ingestion, validation and data quality guardrail, feature engineering, hybrid rules plus ML scoring engine, cost-sensitive threshold manager with capacity constraints, approve or manual review branches with human-in-the-loop escalation, labeled feedback loop for confirmed fraud and false positives, and governance layer including immutable decision logging, drift monitoring, precision tracking, and threshold version control."}


### Reliability Architecture  
- Drift monitoring on fraud rate and precision shifts  
- Guardrail logic for edge-case transactions  
- Human escalation for ambiguous classifications  
- Versioned, audit-ready decision logs  

### My Role  
Principal system designer responsible for architecture, threshold strategy, cross-functional alignment, and production governance model.

### Tech Stack  
Python, scikit-learn, gradient boosting models, SQL, monitoring dashboards, decision logging framework

### What This Demonstrates  
Designing cost-sensitive, auditable decision systems under regulatory pressure.

## Clinical Workflow Optimization  
**Healthtech | Workflow modeling | Operational efficiency**

![](/assets/images/clinical-workflow-banner.png){.banner fig-alt="Diagram showing clinical workflow optimization and task routing logic."}

<div class="metrics-box">
<strong>Impact Snapshot</strong><br>
• Increased routing consistency across care units<br>
• Reduced manual triage burden<br>
• Improved throughput without elevating safety risk
</div>

### Decision Context  
Clinicians operated under fragmented workflows, high cognitive load, and inconsistent triage routing. Documentation and review overhead reduced available patient-facing time.

### Decision at Stake  
Which tasks should be automated, escalated, or preserved for human review to reduce burden while maintaining safety.

### Business Risk  
- Clinician burnout  
- Care delays from routing bottlenecks  
- Variability in triage outcomes  
- Safety exposure from poorly bounded automation  

### My Approach  
Treated workflow friction as a decision system architecture problem.

- Mapped end-to-end care pathways  
- Defined safe automation boundaries with clinical leaders  
- Combined lightweight predictive scoring with deterministic routing  
- Embedded conservative thresholds aligned to safety standards  
- Structured escalation policies for uncertainty  

### Reliability Architecture  
- Human-in-the-loop safeguards  
- Continuous routing consistency monitoring  
- Fail-safe escalation logic  
- Transparent decision logic to preserve trust  

### My Role  
Led system architecture design, stakeholder alignment with clinical leadership, and safe automation boundary definition.

### Tech Stack  
Python, workflow modeling, rules engine framework, lightweight predictive models, operational dashboards

### What This Demonstrates  
Designing human-aligned systems that reduce cognitive load without compromising safety.

## Compliance Automation  
**Fintech | Hybrid architecture | Auditability-first design**

![](/assets/images/compliance-automation-banner.png){.banner fig-alt="Architecture diagram of a compliance automation system combining deterministic rules and ML models."}

<div class="metrics-box">
<strong>Impact Snapshot</strong><br>
• Shortened compliance review cycles<br>
• Increased classification consistency<br>
• Implemented immutable audit trail framework
</div>

### Decision Context  
Manual compliance review processes were slow, inconsistent, and difficult to audit. Regulatory expectations demanded traceable reasoning and defensible intervention logic.

### Decision at Stake  
Which cases require compliance intervention and how regulatory language should translate into operational logic.

### Business Risk  
- Regulatory penalties  
- Legal exposure from undocumented decisions  
- Inconsistent enforcement across teams  
- Scaling limitations in manual review  

### My Approach  
Operationalized regulatory interpretation into scalable decision architecture.

- Translated statutory language into deterministic rules  
- Built statistical scoring for borderline classifications  
- Designed hybrid rule plus ML framework  
- Formalized governance process for threshold updates  

### Reliability Architecture  
- Immutable decision logs  
- Conservative thresholds for high-risk categories  
- Pattern monitoring for anomaly detection  
- Escalation triggers aligned with oversight teams  

### My Role  
Architected hybrid compliance decision system and established governance and auditability framework.

### Tech Stack  
Python, rules engine framework, gradient boosting models, SQL, compliance logging system

### What This Demonstrates  
Operationalizing regulatory requirements into durable, defensible decision systems.
</div>
